Corollary

Step 2. Consider the continuous operator \(T_{1410012}\) acting on the real space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the continuous-real decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1410012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1410012}\).

Step 3. Consider the monotone operator \(T_{1410013}\) acting on the Banach space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the monotone-Banach decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1410013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1410013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via flexible interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1410011} \cdot C_{1410012} \cdot C_{1410013}\).
